rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for expressing “likewise” or “also,” including “me too.”
Use this before a quality or quantity when it exceeds what is wanted or appropriate.

example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 taai3 jit6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for “very” in negative or understated phrases such as 唔係好肯定, rather than 太, which usually suggests excess.

example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 hang2 ding6
